sentences.translation: 在过去的一周，随着故事的发展我体会了各种不同的情绪：震惊、愤怒、悲伤、厌恶和困惑。

sentences.sentence: State authorities have ordered cutbacks in deliveries of water from the delta because of the threat to endangered species of salmon and smelt.
sentences.translation: 由于鲑鱼和胡瓜鱼这些濒危物种受到威胁，国家当局已经要求消减从该三角洲往外输水的量。

sentences.sentence: The oil industry uses supercomputers to trawl seismic data before drilling wells.
sentences.translation: 石油公司可以在钻井之前先拖网分析地震数据。

sentences.sentence: The new analysis used catch data as well as stock assessments, scientific trawl surveys, small-scale fishery data and modelling results.
sentences.translation: 这项新研究利用捕捞量、种群评估、科学的拖网调查、小规模渔业数据以及模型进行分析。

sentences.sentence: But when you go to a tropical rainforest, it's easy to find new insects, and when you go to the deep sea and pull up a trawl, 90% of what you get can be undiscovered species.
sentences.translation: 但是当进入热带雨林后，我们很容易就能发现新种类的昆虫；进入深海区域洒下一张拖网，你捕获的生物有90％是未被发现过的物种。

sentences.sentence: ‘Pass away’ is a euphemism for ‘die’.
sentences.translation: “去世”是“死”的委婉语。

sentences.sentence: When an atheist or agnostic asks me about Sunday School for their children, I recommend exposing their children to a religion.
sentences.translation: 当一个无神论者或不可知论者问我星期天学校的事时，我的建议是让孩子去了解宗教。

sentences.sentence: I have mentioned that Locke was very agnostic.
sentences.translation: 我提到过，洛克是个不可知论者。

sentences.sentence: Forget taxonomy, ontology, and psychology. Who knows why people do what they do?
sentences.translation: 忘记分类，存在论和哲学吧，谁又能知道为什么人们要做他们做的事情？

sentences.sentence: In fact, in Cartesian ontology there are only three kinds of substance: mind, matter and God.
sentences.translation: 其实在笛卡尔的本体论中，世界上只有三种实体：心灵、物质和上帝。

sentences.sentence: The Republic and The Laws, written 2300 to 2400 years ago, dealt not only with philosophy, the theory of knowledge, epistemology, but also with social conditions.
sentences.translation: 他在2300～2400年前写就的《理想国》和《法律篇》不仅阐述了哲学、知识论和认识论，而且还研究了社会状况。

sentences.sentence: But all these endeavors to provide a rational basis for peaceful human cooperation within the frame of society appear vain in the light of the Marxian epistemology.
sentences.translation: 然而，所有这些为人类在社会结构中得以开展和平协作提供理性基础的努力，都由于马克思认识论的出现而成为徒劳之举。

translations.translation: [哲]虚无主义, 极端怀疑论

sentences.sentence: The negation of the infinite leads straight to nihilism.
sentences.translation: 对无极的否认会直接导向虚无主义。

sentences.sentence: And by nihilism, I mean the view that every preference, however squalid, base or sordid, must be regarded as the legitimate equal of every other.
sentences.translation: 我所谓的虚无主义,意指所有偏好，无论如何卑鄙，拙劣，或下贱都必需被视为,与所有其它同等合法。

translations.translation: [植] 兰, 兰花, 淡紫色

sentences.sentence: Orchids and orchid bees are a classic example of this relationship.
sentences.translation: 兰花和兰蜂就是这种关系的典型例子。

translations.translation: [植] 向日葵, 天芥菜属植物, 该植物的花香, 淡紫色

phrases.translation: [口语]别多话!别声张(禁令)!保守秘密!
桉树叶；古柯叶（eucalyptus leaf的复数形式）

sentences.sentence: For skin under and around noses that are irritated by too much blowing, menthol and eucalyptus can relieve pain.
sentences.translation: 鼻子下面和周围发炎的皮肤是由于过度吹风造成的，薄荷和桉树可以减轻疼痛。

sentences.sentence: Sophie Conran, scion of the design dynasty, uses holly and ivy with berries, eucalyptus and pine cones to decorate her home.
sentences.translation: 索菲·康兰这位设计师的后代，用冬青树、带浆果的常青藤、桉树和松树球果来装饰她的家。

translations.translation: [植]柏科树的, 柏木属植物(原产北美、欧、亚), 柏树枝(用作哀悼的标志)

sentences.sentence: ...a solid maple worktop.
sentences.translation: …一张结实的枫木工作台。

sentences.sentence: A ladder fern springs from a crack in the 1979 lava flows from Kilauea Volcano on the Big Island of Hawaii.
sentences.translation: 1979年，夏威夷大岛上蕨类植物生长在基拉韦厄火山所流出的阶梯形的岩浆上。

sentences.sentence: A staple part of the vegetarian dino-diet was probably horsetails, fern-like plants that were abundant in prehistoric swamps and highly nutritious, said the scientists.
sentences.translation: 科学家说，食草恐龙的主要食物大概是楔叶类、类似于蕨类的植物。 这些植物在史前的沼泽地带十分丰富，而且很有营养。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 125 单元

sonata
音标：英 /sə'nɑːtə/  美 /sə'nɑtə/
n. [音]奏鸣曲
短语：sonata form — 奏鸣曲式
例句：a piano sonata
钢琴奏鸣曲

gamut
音标：英 /'gæmət/  美 /'gæmət/
n. [音乐]全音阶, 长音阶, 全音域
短语：color gamut — 色饱和度；颜色范围
例句：As the story unfolded throughout the past week, I experienced the gamut of emotions: shock, anger, sadness, disgust, confusion.
在过去的一周，随着故事的发展我体会了各种不同的情绪：震惊、愤怒、悲伤、厌恶和困惑。

stereotype
音标：英 /'sterɪə(ʊ)taɪp; 'stɪərɪə(ʊ)-/  美 /'stɛrɪətaɪp/
n. [印]铅版, 陈腔滥调, 老套

guru
音标：英 /'gʊruː/  美 /'ɡʊru/
n. [印度教](个人的)宗教老师(或指导), (受下属崇敬的)领袖, 头头

exchequer
音标：英 /ɪks'tʃekə; eks-/  美 /ɪks'tʃɛkɚ/
n. [英史]财物署, 国库, 财源, 财政部
短语：chancellor of the exchequer — 英国财政大臣

salmon
音标：英 /'sæmən/  美 /'sæmən/
n. [鱼]鲑鱼, 大麻哈鱼, 鲜肉色
短语：smoked salmon — 熏制鲑鱼
短语：pacific salmon — [生]太平洋鲑鱼；大鳞大麻哈鱼；大麻哈鱼属（等于Oncorhynchus）
短语：atlantic salmon — 大西洋鲑鱼
短语：salmon pink — 橙红色；浅橙色
短语：king salmon — 大鳞大麻哈鱼；鲑鱼王
短语：pink salmon — 细鳞大麻哈鱼；粉鲑
例句：He gave them a splendid lunch of smoked salmon.
他款待了他们一顿极好的熏三文鱼午餐。

smelt
音标：英 /smelt/  美 /smɛlt/
n. [鱼]胡瓜鱼
短语：smell of — 有…的气味；闻出…的味道
短语：sweet smell — 闻起来香
短语：sense of smell — 嗅觉
短语：bad smell — 坏味道，坏气味
短语：fishy smell — 鱼腥味，鱼臭
短语：smell the flowers — 放松一下，休息一会儿
短语：smell the coffee — 清醒过来，认识到事物的本质
短语：smell out — 嗅出；察觉
例句：State authorities have ordered cutbacks in deliveries of water from the delta because of the threat to endangered species of salmon and smelt.
由于鲑鱼和胡瓜鱼这些濒危物种受到威胁，国家当局已经要求消减从该三角洲往外输水的量。

trawl
音标：英 /trɔːl/  美 /trɔl/
n. [渔] 拖网
例句：The oil industry uses supercomputers to trawl seismic data before drilling wells.
石油公司可以在钻井之前先拖网分析地震数据。
例句：The new analysis used catch data as well as stock assessments, scientific trawl surveys, small-scale fishery data and modelling results.
这项新研究利用捕捞量、种群评估、科学的拖网调查、小规模渔业数据以及模型进行分析。
例句：But when you go to a tropical rainforest, it's easy to find new insects, and when you go to the deep sea and pull up a trawl, 90% of what you get can be undiscovered species.
但是当进入热带雨林后，我们很容易就能发现新种类的昆虫；进入深海区域洒下一张拖网，你捕获的生物有90％是未被发现过的物种。

euphemism
音标：英 /'juːfəmɪz(ə)m/  美 /'jufəmɪzəm/
n. [语法]委婉的说法
例句：‘Pass away’ is a euphemism for ‘die’.
“去世”是“死”的委婉语。

agnostic
音标：英 /æg'nɒstɪk/  美 /æg'nɑstɪk/
n. [哲]不可知论者
例句：When an atheist or agnostic asks me about Sunday School for their children, I recommend exposing their children to a religion.
当一个无神论者或不可知论者问我星期天学校的事时，我的建议是让孩子去了解宗教。
例句：I have mentioned that Locke was very agnostic.
我提到过，洛克是个不可知论者。

ontology
音标：英 /ɒn'tɒlədʒɪ/  美 /ɑn'tɑlədʒi/
n. [哲]存在论
例句：Forget taxonomy, ontology, and psychology. Who knows why people do what they do?
忘记分类，存在论和哲学吧，谁又能知道为什么人们要做他们做的事情？
例句：In fact, in Cartesian ontology there are only three kinds of substance: mind, matter and God.
其实在笛卡尔的本体论中，世界上只有三种实体：心灵、物质和上帝。

epistemology
音标：英 /ɪ,pɪstɪ'mɒlədʒɪ; e-/  美 /ɪ,pɪstə'mɑlədʒi/
n. [哲]认识论
例句：The Republic and The Laws, written 2300 to 2400 years ago, dealt not only with philosophy, the theory of knowledge, epistemology, but also with social conditions.
他在2300～2400年前写就的《理想国》和《法律篇》不仅阐述了哲学、知识论和认识论，而且还研究了社会状况。
例句：But all these endeavors to provide a rational basis for peaceful human cooperation within the frame of society appear vain in the light of the Marxian epistemology.
然而，所有这些为人类在社会结构中得以开展和平协作提供理性基础的努力，都由于马克思认识论的出现而成为徒劳之举。

nihilism
音标：英 /'naɪ(h)ɪlɪz(ə)m/  美 /'naɪɪlɪzəm/
n. [哲]虚无主义, 极端怀疑论
例句：The negation of the infinite leads straight to nihilism.
对无极的否认会直接导向虚无主义。
例句：And by nihilism, I mean the view that every preference, however squalid, base or sordid, must be regarded as the legitimate equal of every other.
我所谓的虚无主义,意指所有偏好，无论如何卑鄙，拙劣，或下贱都必需被视为,与所有其它同等合法。

orchid
音标：英 /'ɔːkɪd/  美 /'ɔrkɪd/
n. [植] 兰, 兰花, 淡紫色
例句：Orchids and orchid bees are a classic example of this relationship.
兰花和兰蜂就是这种关系的典型例子。

heliotrope
音标：英 /'hiːlɪətrəʊp; 'hel-/  美 /'hɛlɪətrop/
n. [植] 向日葵, 天芥菜属植物, 该植物的花香, 淡紫色

mum
音标：英 /mʌm/  美 /mʌm/
n. [植](=chrysanthemum)菊花, 沉默
短语：keep mum — 保持沉默
短语：mum's the word — [口语]别多话!别声张(禁令)!保守秘密!

eucalyptus
音标：英 /,juːkə'lɪptəs/  美 /,jukə'lɪptəs/
n. [植]桉树
短语：eucalyptus oil — 桉叶油；桉油；桉树油
短语：eucalyptus leaves — 桉树叶；古柯叶（eucalyptus leaf的复数形式）
短语：eucalyptus globulus — 蓝桉，蓝桉树；尤加利
例句：For skin under and around noses that are irritated by too much blowing, menthol and eucalyptus can relieve pain.
鼻子下面和周围发炎的皮肤是由于过度吹风造成的，薄荷和桉树可以减轻疼痛。
例句：Sophie Conran, scion of the design dynasty, uses holly and ivy with berries, eucalyptus and pine cones to decorate her home.
索菲·康兰这位设计师的后代，用冬青树、带浆果的常青藤、桉树和松树球果来装饰她的家。

cypress
音标：英 /'saɪprəs/  美 /'saɪprəs/
n. [植]柏科树的, 柏木属植物(原产北美、欧、亚), 柏树枝(用作哀悼的标志)

maple
音标：英 /'meɪp(ə)l/  美 /'mepl/
n. [植]枫, 枫木, 淡棕色
短语：maple leaf — n. 枫叶
短语：maple syrup — n. 枫蜜；糖枫汁
短语：maple tree — 枫树
短语：red maple — 红枫；红花槭，红槭
短语：sugar maple — n. 糖枫
短语：hard maple — 硬枫木
例句：...a solid maple worktop.
…一张结实的枫木工作台。

fern
音标：英 /fɜːn/  美 /fɝn/
n. [植]蕨类植物
例句：A ladder fern springs from a crack in the 1979 lava flows from Kilauea Volcano on the Big Island of Hawaii.
1979年，夏威夷大岛上蕨类植物生长在基拉韦厄火山所流出的阶梯形的岩浆上。
例句：A staple part of the vegetarian dino-diet was probably horsetails, fern-like plants that were abundant in prehistoric swamps and highly nutritious, said the scientists.
科学家说，食草恐龙的主要食物大概是楔叶类、类似于蕨类的植物。 这些植物在史前的沼泽地带十分丰富，而且很有营养。
